maddeler.e: جَلْجَلَ • (jaljala) Iq (non-past يُجَلْجِلُ (yujaljilu), verbal noun جَلْجَلَة (jaljala))
maddeler.t: Onomatopoeic or denominal verb from the plant جُلْجُلان (juljulān).
g: to thud, to rattle, to jingle, to shake
